01 — About me

Adib Hasan Ornob.

I’m Adib Hasan Ornob, creatively known as ORNOB — a photographer and aspiring filmmaker exploring cinematic storytelling, motion graphics, graphic design, and creative coding. Currently studying Computer Science and Engineering at IUT, I enjoy blending technology with visual creativity to create distinctive experiences.
